text:
Predicates:
MountainRange(x) ::: x is a mountain range.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Visited(x, y) ::: x visited y.
Mine(x) ::: x is a mine.
Donated(x) ::: x was donated.
Premises:
(MountainRange(picuris) ∧ LocatedIn(picuris, newmexico)) ∨ (MountainRange(picuris) ∧ LocatedIn(picuris, texas)) ::: The Picuris Mountains are a mountain range in New Mexico or Texas.
Visited(juan, picuris) ::: Juan de Onate visited the Picuris Mountains.
Mine(harding) ∧ LocatedIn(harding, picuris) ∧ Donated(harding) ::: The Harding Pegmatite Mine, located in the Picuris Mountains, was donated.
¬∃x (MountainRange(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, texas) ∧ Mine(x) ∧ Donated(x)) ::: There are no mountain ranges in texas that have mines which have been donated.
Conclusion:
Visited(juan, picuris) ∧ LocatedIn(picuris, newmexico) ::: Juan de Onate visited a mountain range in New Mexico.
